tools.name: create_template
tools.description:
Create a JSXImage template from JSX source code and get a link to it. The link opens the template in the JSXImage playground with a live preview, and works for 7 days. No account is needed to create or open it.

You write the whole template as source code: a default-exported React function component

tools.name: modify_template
tools.description:
Change a JSXImage template that the user shared with you as a link (a URL containing `shared=` or `temp=`, for example https://jsximage.com/playground?shared=...). Works in two steps:

1. Call with only `url`: you get the template's current source code.
2. Make the requested changes, then call again

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "create_template" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
